parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: ${9(x-2)^2-28}$ — B2,1,0. B2 for all 3 correct values; B1 for any two correct. Allow $p=9$, $q=-2$, $r=-28$. If contradictory, give preference to the expression. Condone correct values in an expression of the correct form even if the square on the bracket is missing. Allow B1 for $9(x-2)^2+k$. Total 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $(x-2)^2=\frac{13}{9}$ from their completed square, or use the quadratic formula — M1. Solving as far as $(x+\text{their }q)^2=\cdots$; allow sign errors only in rearrangement. $x=2\pm\frac{\sqrt{13}}3$ (or exact equivalent) — A1; ISW if decimals follow exact answers. Total 2.
